title: Flovr component
description: A component.yaml of Flovr, which the page calls a service: what it takes, one kind of work or steps of its own, and its tests. A step uses it with use: and with:.

flovr.description: The version of the file format. A file that leaves it out is in format 1.

description.description: A line on what it is for, shown where a component is chosen.

input.description: What it takes, as name: type. Inside, expressions read each as input.<name>.

steps.description: Steps of its own, run in order as in a workflow.

output.description: With steps: what it gives back, a value that may take values from them.

input.description: The values to give it, or a JSON file that holds them.
